@T.prim_func
def matmul_fp16_kernel(
    A: T.handle,               # shape (M, K), dtype=float16
    B: T.handle,               # shape (K, N), dtype=float16
    C: T.handle,               # shape (M, N), dtype=float16
    M: T.int32,
    K: T.int32,
    N: T.int32,
):
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Buffer declarations
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    A_buf = T.match_buffer(A, (M, K), dtype="float16")
    B_buf = T.match_buffer(B, (K, N), dtype="float16")
    C_buf = T.match_buffer(C, (M, N), dtype="float16")

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Thread/block axes (CUDA)
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    tx = T.env_thread("threadIdx.x")
    ty = T.env_thread("threadIdx.y")
    bx = T.env_thread("blockIdx.x")
    by = T.env_thread("blockIdx.y")

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Tile sizes (tuned for RTX 6000 Ada/Blackwell)
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    BM = 128  # rows per block
    BN = 128  # cols per block
    BK = 32   # reduction tile size

    # Shared memory buffers
    As = T.alloc_shared((BM, BK), dtype="float16")
    Bs = T.alloc_shared((BK, BN), dtype="float16")

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Compute block base indices
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    i_base = by * BM
    j_base = bx * BN

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Accumulator in float32 for higher precision
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    acc = T.alloc_local((BM, BN), dtype="float32")
    for i, j in T.grid(BM, BN):
        acc[i, j] = T.float32(0.0)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Loop over K dimension in tiles of size BK
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

            a_i = i_base + i
            a_k = kk + k
            with T.if_then_else((a_i < M) & (a_k < K), True, False) as ib:
                with ib.then():
                    As[i, k] = A_buf[a_i, a_k]
                with ib.else_():
                    As[i, k] = T.float16(0.0)

        # ------------------------------------------------------------------
        # Load B tile into shared memory
        # ------------------------------------------------------------------
        for k, j in T.grid(BK, BN):
            b_k = kk + k
            b_j = j_base + j
            with T.if_then_else((b_k < K) & (b_j < N), True, False) as ib:
                with ib.then():

                with ib.else_():
